query:
SELECT au.id as userId, au.email, au.name, au.tokenBalance,
       ua.id as actionId, ua.actionType, ua.feature, ua.description, ua.segmentCount, ua.createdAt
FROM app_users au
LEFT JOIN user_actions ua ON ua.appUserId = au.id
WHERE au.email = 'yossi2700@gmail.com'
ORDER BY ua.createdAt DESC
LIMIT 10;
